title: Documentation consistency check: every repo path cited in the governing docs must exist, and every doc-stated count must match the committed artifact

scope.summary: Mechanically verify the governing documentation set for (a) dead repo-path references (a doc cites qamus/... or tools/... or docs/... that does not exist in the tree), (b) stale counts (a doc states a row/sample/entry count that disagrees with the committed file it describes), and (c) schema-id drift (a doc names a schema id that no file under qamus/schemas/ declares). Output is a findings report; NOTHING is repaired by this packet.
out_of_scope: editing any documentation or artifact (findings only — repairs are separate, owner/lane-routed work)
external URLs (network is out of scope; repo-relative paths only)
judging linguistic content, wording, or style

tools_required: git (git ls-files as the existence oracle — the INDEX, not the working tree, defines what is committed)

commands.purpose: Extract candidate repo-path references from each input doc (regex over backtick-quoted and bare paths matching (docs|qamus|tools|curriculum)/...), then test each against git ls-files
commands.run: python - (inline: for each input doc, extract paths, normalize, check membership in `git ls-files` output; directory refs pass if any tracked file has the prefix; emit one findings row per dead ref)
commands.expect: findings rows with doc, line number, cited path, and failure kind dead_path

commands.purpose: Verify doc-stated counts against committed artifacts for the enumerated claim set: HANDOFF-RECORD sample inventory count vs actual qamus/examples/website-payloads/*.payload.json file count; pilot README's 12 occurrences / 78 appearances / 49 typed facts vs qamus/examples/p007-li-pilot/ artifact row counts; p007 partition sizes in qamus/lattice/p007-population-classification.meta.json vs recomputed tallies from the jsonl
commands.run: python - (inline recount; emit one findings row per mismatch with stated vs actual)
commands.expect: count claims verified by recomputation, never by trusting a second doc

commands.purpose: Schema-id drift: every `qamus.*.v*` schema id named in the input docs must be declared by a file under qamus/schemas/ or emitted by a committed tool/sample (grep over qamus/schemas/ + qamus/examples/)
commands.run: python - (inline: collect schema ids from docs; search declarations; emit findings rows for orphans)
commands.expect: orphan schema ids enumerated with the doc+line that cites them

candidate_population.selection_rule: Not an occurrence-population packet: the population is the fixed 10-file governing-doc list in input_files, checked exhaustively.

expected_outputs.description: one row per finding: {doc, line, kind: dead_path|stale_count|orphan_schema_id, cited, actual}
summary: files checked, refs checked, findings per class, zero-findings statement if clean; explicit list of checks NOT performed (external URLs, prose accuracy)

evidence_policy.statement: Every finding is mechanically reproducible from committed files: the finding row carries the doc line and the recomputed actual value. No linguistic or editorial judgment is involved anywhere in this packet.
evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: A path that cannot be classified confidently (ambiguous prose, template placeholder like batchNN.tsv or <custody:...>) is recorded as kind=skipped_ambiguous with the reason — never guessed into a dead_path finding and never silently dropped.

guards: Findings only — the METHOD (mechanical checks) is the whole packet; no conclusion about what a doc SHOULD say transfers to the executor, and no repair is attempted.
The existence oracle is git ls-files (committed state), not the working tree — untracked scratch must not mask a dead ref.
Counts are verified by recomputation from the primary artifact, never by cross-quoting another document.
Placeholder/template path shapes (angle brackets, NN batch numbers, glob stars, opaque dawahwiki: refs) are structurally exempt and logged as skipped_ambiguous.
defeaters: Opaque out-of-git refs (dawahwiki:packets/..., custody designations): NOT dead paths — they are custody refs per docs/evidence-custody.md section 2; flagging one as dead_path is a false positive that voids the findings class.
Historical/quoted paths inside changelog-style prose (a doc quoting a former state): record as skipped_ambiguous unless the doc presents the path as currently existing.
Glob and prefix references (qamus/examples/website-payloads/*.payload.json): pass if the glob matches at least one tracked file.

positive.expectation: the sample-inventory table row count equals the tracked *.payload.json count under qamus/examples/website-payloads/ (11 after the same-surface pair landed); a mismatch here proves the counter works
its cited tools/validate_p007_pilot.py resolves in git ls-files

adversarial.expectation: before the real run, the executor plants a fake citation (e.g. qamus/examples/DOES-NOT-EXIST.jsonl) in a COPY of one input doc under the scratch area and confirms the checker flags it; a checker that passes the planted ref is broken — STOP
MUST be classified as an opaque custody ref, NOT a dead path

acceptance_tests.name: determinism
acceptance_tests.run: run the full check twice and diff the findings files

acceptance_tests.name: red-first sanity
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: planted ref detected; real run contains no planted artifacts

non_deployment.statement: Read-only audit with a two-file report output; no documentation, artifact, schema, or live surface is modified. Repairs are separate routed work.

conditions: any input doc is missing from the tree (the governing-doc list itself is stale — packet needs re-issue)
more than 25 dead-path findings in one doc (likely a systematic move/rename — route to the owning lane rather than enumerating noise)
the red-first planted ref is NOT detected
escalation_trigger.route: STOP; write the partial findings + stop reason to qamus/reports/doc-linkcheck-w1.md and hand back to the Fusha certifier lane for packet re-issue or lane routing

definition_of_done: both report files committed; every findings row carries doc+line+kind+cited+actual
red-first planted-ref check performed and documented
all three acceptance tests pass; zero writes outside permitted paths

cites: docs/evidence-custody.md section 2 (opaque custody refs are not dead paths)
tools/check_regressions.py fixture-first discipline (committed state is the oracle)
